_doc: FOURTH HELD-OUT real project: SOEM, the Simple Open EtherCAT Master (samples/realworld/SOEM, ~25K lines; industrial fieldbus master with Linux and Windows (wpcap) ports; uncompiled — the CMake-generated ec_options.h is missing). Questions written from facts verified in the source AFTER all Phase 3 (CANopenNode) fixes and BEFORE Verity was ever run on it. First run kept in bench/results/realworld_heldout4/first-run.*.

cases.q: What happens when there are more slaves on the network than EC_MAXSLAVE?
Where is the slave count set?
What happens when the error list is full?
What happens when a slave answers an SDO read with an abort?
What happens when no reply to a frame arrives?
How is an EtherCAT frame sent on the network?
What does ecx_poperror return when the error list is empty?
How does the mailbox counter wrap around?
